{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the first few rows of revenue to confirm it's string with commas
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas and non-numeric characters
print('\nUnique revenue values with commas:')
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check for the special QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Display dtype of revenue
print(f'\nDtype of revenue column: {df["revenue"].dtype}')"}
